newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Novosibirskenergo 96 net up to 306 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia Novosibirskenergo 96 net up to 306 bln rbls.

text.p: Russian power utility OAO Novosibirskenergo's 1996 preliminary net profit, to Russian accrual accounting standards, rose to 306.0 billion roubles, a consultant for the company said on Friday.
Dmitry Zhurba, Deputy Executive Director at Soyuz Energoservis Association, Novosibirskenergo's financial consultant, told Reuters net profits had risen from 242.0 billion roubles in 1995.

NOTE - Novosibirskenergo spokesman Vadim Matveyev said electricity sales fell by 1.5 percent to 10.19 million kilowatt/hours in 1996 compared to 1995 levels. Heat energy sales rose by 8.5 percent to 12.19 million gigacalories.
In 1996 Novosibirskenergo bought 25.6 of needed electricity, or 3.3 billion kilowatt/hour on the Federal Wholesale Electricity Market.

Novosibirskenergo's biggest shareholders are the regional administration with 20 percent of shares, national power utility Unified Energy System (UES) with 12 percent and Russia's IFK Alemar with 29 percent.
